shot 17: 01:50.21-~01:58, wide in golden light; WAITRESS seated on a stool, customer side; ~01:51 she stands and leans over the counter; ~01:51.8 a second identical waitress appears at the back by A3 while the first moves right onto the service side; both are visible until ~01:56, then one remains

findings.invariant_violated: single instance of a person / no duplicate
findings.description: In the final wide shot the waitress gets up from a customer-side stool (01:50.2-01:51.5). By ~01:51.8 a second figure in the same blue uniform and white apron is standing at the back near the kitchen pass, while the original walks right along the service side to the coffee machines. Both are visible at once from ~01:52 to ~01:56 (frames 113-117). This is the same character duplicated, not a new person entering.

findings.invariant_violated: opposite side of anchor with no visible crossing
findings.description: The waitress starts on a customer-side stool at 01:50.2. Within about 1 s she is behind the counter on the service side at the right (01:52-01:53). She never walks round the counter end: in the 01:51.8-01:52.3 frames her legs are still in front of the counter base while her torso is already behind the counter top, so she passes through the counter.

findings.invariant_violated: opposite side of anchor with no visible crossing
findings.description: In the continuous wide shot that starts at 01:17.6, the waitress stands on the service side of the counter facing the man (01:18-01:20). By ~01:21-01:22 she is seated beside him on the customer side, with her feet down by the stools (frame 84). The dense 4 fps samples show her sliding sideways into his position with no walk round the counter end, and there is no cut to explain the move. Shot 12 (01:26.8) then shows them both seated on the customer side, so the impossible crossing carries on into the next shot.

In the wide shot that starts at 00:36.46, the man's jeans and legs show in front of and below the counter's front panel on the customer side, yet his torso, arms and mug sit behind the counter top, with the plate between him and the camera. No stool is visible under him, and the stool row stops to his left. He looks embedded in the counter rather than seated at it, unlike shot 3 (00:24-00:27), where he clearly sits on a stool in front of the counter.

findings.entity: Waitress, pose and orientation across cut-009
findings.description: Just before the cut (01:17.54, medium) the waitress has her back to the camera and is walking away toward the back counter. Just after it (01:17.58, wide) she is at the counter right beside the man, turned toward him and leaning on the counter, without the distance she had just covered. The two shots are a matched continuation, so no elapsed time accounts for the change.
